about.subtitle: Photographer & Visual Storyteller
about.title: Hello, we are chinphotos
about.tagline: Natural Family & Childhood Photographer in Ho Chi Minh City
about.storyHeading: Philosophy: Honest human connection over posed perfection
about.storyP1: chinphotos was born from the heartfelt belief that the most irreplaceable photographs aren't formal studio portraits, but the quiet moments in between: a tender look, a child's tight embrace, and the sweet chaos of family life.
about.storyP2: We photograph exclusively with natural light, moving at the child's natural pace. No forced smiles, no awkward posing. Each session is a gentle outing where children can simply be themselves, leaving you with memories of sunlit mornings and unconditional love.
about.storyP3: Armed with prime lenses and an editorial eye for color, we preserve skin tones with gentle warmth and capture Ho Chi Minh City's golden sunshine in timeless clarity.
about.locationsTitle: Beloved Locations Across Ho Chi Minh City
about.locationsSubtitle: From tranquil green parks and riverfront promenades to the warmth of your own living room.
about.ctaTitle: Ready to document your family's golden chapters?

details.subtitle: Experience & Process
details.title: A Thoughtful, Relaxed Journey
details.description: Every session is carefully tailored from styling consultations to final delivery so you can simply relax and enjoy.
details.step1Desc: We learn your family's rhythm and preferences, helping you select the ideal setting (at home or outdoors) and cohesive styling palettes.
details.step2Desc: We take time to play and connect with your child first. The session unfolds naturally as a peaceful stroll with zero forced posing.
details.step3Desc: Each image is individually edited for authentic color, radiant skin tones, and rich emotional atmosphere while keeping the natural look intact.
details.step4Desc: Receive full-resolution photographs through a private digital gallery, along with custom fine-art heirloom albums if desired.
